title: Mass sighting near hometown explained as Jupiter

tellings.quote: because there was this huge observation

plain: Near Mariestad, Sweden, many people once reported a big sighting in the sky that was later explained as the planet Jupiter. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn, who says he was there and part of it, tells it in a 2026 episode. He describes it only as "this huge observation" near his hometown.
